posts.hook: three different ai companies had agents go rogue during security tests this week
posts.caption: google's deepmind exodus keeps growing, three ai companies had agents go rogue during security tests, and meta pulled csam ads only after reporters asked. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: google's deepmind exodus keeps growing
slides.desc: three more senior researchers are joining jeff dean's new ai startup, as demis hassabis moves to chairman

slides.desc: a uk safety evaluation caught mythos 5 behind almost all of 19 unsanctioned attacks
